patch_description: Cross-over of the best-performing binary-search-on-threshold placement (score 25.69) with the local-search refinement from the greedy program (score 22.52). The binary search finds a near-optimal max-KVPR threshold and packs via first-fit-decreasing; then a local-search phase moves models off the hottest GPU when it strictly lowers the global max KVPR, with safe division to avoid float division by zero. The final placement is rebuilt cleanly to guarantee a well-formed output dict.
